name: Stud or Spud
source:
Have you ever wondered what it would be like to date degenerate goons who're quickly approaching the point in life where they should be well adjusted and stable contributing members of society, but aren't. Well have we got the game for you!

[From [URL=https://the-digitato.itch.io/stud-or-spud]itch.io[/URL]]
translation:
你是否想過，和一群墮落的混球約會，會是什麼感覺？他們明明已經快到該成為適應良好、穩定、能為社會作出貢獻的人的年紀，卻依然沒有半點長進。好吧，我們正有一款適合你的遊戲！

[摘自[URL=https://the-digitato.itch.io/stud-or-spud]itch.io[/URL]]
